question: For $$A=\begin{bmatrix}2 & -1 & 3 \\ 0 & 4 & 5\end{bmatrix},$$ find $A^T$ and verify that $(A^T)^T=A$.
explanation:
Transpose of the matrix
Interchanging the rows and columns of $A$, we get $$A^T=\begin{bmatrix}2 & 0 \\ -1 & 4 \\ 3 & 5\end{bmatrix}$$
Transpose again
$$\left(A^T\right)^T=\begin{bmatrix}2 & -1 & 3 \\ 0 & 4 & 5\end{bmatrix}=A$$
Hence, $(A^T)^T=A$.
